steps.name: open the bill and download the lines
steps.whatHappens: Open the queue and pull the overnight complaints.
steps.decidedHow: the queue is what arrived while nobody was watching

steps.name: check each line against the handset list
steps.whatHappens: Read each complaint and tag what kind it is.
steps.decidedHow: the type decides who answers it

steps.name: check the line against the contract
steps.whatHappens: Look up the order and when it was meant to arrive.
steps.decidedHow: the dates decide whether it is urgent

steps.name: note the line and mark the issue type
steps.whatHappens: Note the complaint and what was decided.
steps.decidedHow: the note is what the agent sees

steps.name: total the charges and write the summary
steps.whatHappens: Close the complaint once it is assigned.
